name: CRAG_FREEBASE_CANONICAL
written_before: any byte of the 31.3 GB raw mirror was downloaded, so the contract cannot be shaped by what the dump turns out to make convenient.

IDIR_BACKBONE_AS_V3.not_because: IDIR is bad. Its retained graph is remarkably clean -- 99.998% exact structural agreement with zero reverse-only cases on every predicate it keeps.
IDIR_BACKBONE_AS_V3.but_because: its preprocessing intentionally removes information CRAG treats as first-class.

decisive_evidence.reading: FB+CVT+REV differs from the backbone in exactly one step -- the reverse anti-join -- and rescues 97 of 488,432 nodes. The cause is isolated to the MID-only endpoint filter, not reverse-edge removal.

IDIR_BACKBONE_AS_V3.why_it_is_decisive_for_CRAG_specifically: the retrieval-role decision made every CVT retrieval-eligible and a first-class partition-routing anchor. Adopting IDIR as the backbone would knowingly delete 30.76% of the node class the architecture had just promoted.

RAW_FREEBASE_REQUIRED_FOR_V3.because: the missing CVTs and literals are now directly measured rather than hypothesised.

measured.literal_valued_facts: absent by construction from every IDIR variant
measured.reverse_property_mapping: absent from the archive (FINDING_1), leaving INVARIANT_2 bounded but uncomputable

ROLES.how_they_combine: raw Freebase is authority; IDIR metadata is fast lookup and validation, with raw filling whatever IDIR lacks.
ROLES.the_oracle_is_load_bearing: IDIR proved its retained graph is trustworthy where it exists. That means the raw parser does not have to be built blind: every stage can be validated against 134,142,730 delivered triples with a known 99.998% agreement target.
ROLES.and_it_doubles_as_a_provenance_check: the archive.org mirror is a third-party custody copy; Google's own endpoint is dead (403), so there is no upstream digest to check against. If a raw build reproduces IDIR's retained triples at the expected rate, that is independent evidence the mirror is the dataset it claims to be. Recorded as a real limitation with a real mitigation, not as a solved problem.

LITERAL_UID.rule: literal_uid = lexical form + datatype + language tag / literal class
LITERAL_UID.consequence: plain "1992", a typed gYear 1992 and another typed numeric 1992 cannot silently become one node.
LITERAL_UID.provenance: the original RDF lexical representation is preserved separately.
LITERAL_UID.why_restated: it is the same identity-collapse bug class that name-keying caused in the RoG lineage, in a different form. Restating it in the contract keeps the two locks from drifting apart.

DECIDED_BY_USER.SOURCE_EXPANSION: the source must NEVER be expanded to its documented ~250 GB uncompressed form. Stream from gzip throughout.

PIPELINE.shape: streaming staged, not one pass to a perfect 60M+ node Parquet graph
PIPELINE.reason: space is the real constraint, not compute.

PASS_B.does: subject-matter triples -> canonical node IDs -> external-sort edge shards

PASS_C.does: literal terms -> typed literal nodes, under LITERAL_UID

PIPELINE.note_on_pass_D: RULE_2 aligns to IDIR's orientation, which check 4 verified against delivered data. But CRAG stores ONE canonical edge with a reverse_relation attribute rather than deleting the reverse predicate, so PASS_D canonicalises rather than filters. IDIR's anti-join and CRAG's canonicalisation agree on direction and disagree on what happens to the other name.

ADMIN_MEDIATORS_ABLATION_PREREGISTERED.decision: DO NOT REMOVE THEM FROM THE CORPUS.
ADMIN_MEDIATORS_ABLATION_PREREGISTERED.why: CRAG begins from the complete graph and lets evidence say whether a family is noise. Deciding during corpus construction that they are not knowledge is exactly the move the ALL_NODE decision rejected.
ADMIN_MEDIATORS_ABLATION_PREREGISTERED.becomes: ALL_NODE vs ALL_NODE - ADMIN_MEDIATORS, an ablation arm alongside the existing ENTITY_ONLY / ALL_NODE / ALL_NODE - LITERAL / ALL_NODE - CVT set.
ADMIN_MEDIATORS_ABLATION_PREREGISTERED.registered_before: the raw build exists, so the arm cannot be invented after seeing which way the numbers went.

EVIDENCE_CORRECTION_TO_CHECK_6.what_was_reported: 41.923% of NSM MIDs are named by IDIR.
EVIDENCE_CORRECTION_TO_CHECK_6.why_that_framing_understates_it: the denominator is dominated by CVTs, which genuinely have no names in Freebase. 0 of 1,588,085 V1 CVT nodes are named, correctly.
EVIDENCE_CORRECTION_TO_CHECK_6.reading: IDIR names essentially every ordinary entity it holds. The overall figure is a composition artifact, not a coverage gap, and the earlier presentation of it was misleading.
EVIDENCE_CORRECTION_TO_CHECK_6.unchanged: the gold-answer and topic figures were already reported on their own denominators and stand: answers 99.606% named / 99.966% typed, topics 99.992% both.

WHAT_THIS_CONTRACT_DOES_NOT_SETTLE: whether the raw dump's CVT population matches V1's 1,588,085 classification -- V1's node kinds came from a lossy RoG surface and the raw build gets to reclassify from source

the CVT-vs-entity classifier itself: types alone were measured NOT separable (68.1% of CVT type mass sits on types entities also carry, against a 5% pre-registered threshold). A ratio-threshold rule looks promising but needs its own pre-registration
the encoder bill for a 60M+ node corpus, which remains a delayed-representation question and not a corpus-size question
CONTRACT_HASH_NOTE: sha256 over the contract with this field absent. Any later change to the contract must appear as a new record with its own hash, never as an edit that leaves this one looking prescient.
